attr.title: Dead Space
attr.desc: The 2011 Dead Space mobile survival-horror game, running its original Android ARM library directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: Supply your own extracted Xperia Play v1.1.33 game files. Copy assets/ and lib/armeabi/libEAMGameDeadSpace.so into ports/deadspace/. The supported native-library SHA1 is 0ed42b611415015807f759ec9b5457857143ce39. No game data is included.
